name: Rocket Propulsion
description: This course provides an in-depth study of the fundamentals of rocket propulsion, including the thermodynamics of the combustion chamber and nozzle.

name: Aerodynamics
description: This course explores the principles of aerodynamics and how airflow interacts with wings, airfoils, and other flying bodies.

name: Spacecraft Design
description: This course covers spacecraft structures, propulsion, thermal control, and power systems.

name: Organic Chemistry
description: An introduction to the structure, properties, and reactions of organic compounds.

name: Inorganic Chemistry
description: A survey of the chemistry of the elements and their inorganic compounds.
